g.text: EPS growth ≥25% YoY · Revenue ≥20% · RS line beating SPY · RS Rating ≥85
Stage 2 — confirm the stock is in an uptrend
Price above rising 30-week SMA · At least 30% above 52w low before base started

svg.text: Stage 4 & 5 — find tightness and a priming pattern (daily chart)
Tight area = range ≤1.5% of price, vol ≤50% of avg
Inside bar: today's range inside yesterday's
Reversal: dropped intraday, closed near highs
Tight setup day: ≤1% range, vol ≤40% avg

g.text: Early entry: buy above the inside bar/tight day high · Stop = low of tight area
Standard entry: buy 0.5% above pivot on 2x+ volume surge
Risk must be ≤4% from entry to stop · Size: $risk ÷ (entry − stop) = shares
Trail stop up to 10 EMA (fast) or 21 EMA (normal) · Exit if close below on volume
Climax warning: +25% in 5 weeks + vol surge + weak close

svg.text: RS line — how it behaves through the process
RS rising in base = leading signal
